records.source: A shirt with a bandana to shield your neck from harm.
records.translation: Isang kamisetang may bandana upang ipagsanggalang ang leeg mo sa pinsala.

records.source: It's a tourist shirt from the Fern Islands.
records.translation: Isang kamisetang panturista mula sa Kapuluan ng Fern.

records.source: It comes pre-rubbed with potting soil.
records.translation: Kinuskos na ito ng lupang pangpaso bago mo pa isuot.

records.source: A shirt with a bandana to keep your neck soft.
records.translation: Isang kamisetang may bandana upang panatilihing malambot ang leeg mo.

records.source: A shirt that looks like a big slime.
Look sharp while digging for fossils.
records.translation: Magmukhang makisig habang naghuhukay ng mga fossil.

records.source: Knock it out of the park with this classic look.
records.translation: Magpasikat gamit ang klasikong hitsurang ito.

records.source: Wear your heart on your sleeves with this extra soft garment.
records.translation: Isuot ang puso mo sa manggas gamit ang napakalambot na kasuotang ito.

records.source: A dark denim jacket lined with fleece.
records.translation: Isang madilim na dyaket na denim na may sapin na malambot na tela.

records.source: A shirt inspired by the most evocative time of day.
records.translation: Isang kamisetang hango sa oras ng araw na pinakapumupukaw sa damdamin.

records.source: The traditional uniform of a head chef.
records.translation: Ang tradisyonal na uniporme ng isang punong kusinero.

records.source: It smells like the brine of the sea.
You can feel a certain power from this garment.
records.translation: Mararamdaman mo ang tiyak na kapangyarihan mula sa kasuotang ito.

records.source: Classic overalls with a shirt that can be dyed.
records.translation: Klasikong oberol na may kamisetang maaaring kulayan.

records.source: Classic overalls with a sleeveless shirt that can be dyed.
records.translation: Klasikong oberol na may kamisetang walang manggas at maaaring kulayan.

records.source: Classic overalls with a white shirt and belt.
records.translation: Klasikong oberol na may puting kamiseta at sinturon.
Isang malambot na sweater na kardigan na de-butones.

records.source: A shirt featuring a prominent 'sign of the vessel'.
records.translation: Isang kamisetang may kapansin-pansing “sagisag ng sisidlan”.

records.source: A shirt with a gold necklace.
A velvety black coat with a prominent belt.
records.translation: Isang malapelus na itim na amerikana na may kapansin-pansing sinturon.
